CBFT.description: Bending Coefficient Cb (CBFT). Keyed by element id; sets the lateral-torsional buckling bending coefficient Cb, either auto-calculated by the program or as a user value. Requires the AIJ-ASD02 steel design code to be activated first via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. DELETE removes the Cb assignment from the element.

AUTO_CAL.description: Auto Calculate by Program. If true, Cb is computed by the program and VALUE is ignored (stored as 0.0).

VALUE.description: [AUTO_CAL=false] Bending Coefficient (Cb) value. Must satisfy 1.0 <= VALUE <= 2.3 (out-of-range is rejected); ignored when AUTO_CAL is true.
